title: CGF Influence on Post-operative Complications.
brief_summary: The aim of the study is to evaluate the influence of CGF application into post-operative soft tissue and bone defects on post-operative complications and wound healing.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* no known medical history of abnormal platelet counts,
* patients with symmetric teeth qualified for extraction,

Exclusion Criteria:

* systemic diseases,
* pregnancy,
* lactation,
* drugs known to affect the number or function of platelets,
* abnormal platelet counts
